seoTitle: Northshore School District Calendar 2026–27: Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Find NSD’s 2026–27 first and last days, breaks, Wednesday early releases, conference dismissals, make-up days, and official calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Northshore School District’s 2026–27 school year begins Tuesday, Sept. 1, 2026, for most grades. Winter Break is Dec. 21–Jan. 1, Mid-Winter Break is Feb. 16–19, and Spring Break is April 5–9. The scheduled last day is Wednesday, June 16, 2027; emergency make-up days could extend the school year as late as June 22.
heroFactChips: Elementary conference early dismissals: Nov. 17, 19–20, 23–24, and Feb. 5 by invitation only

schemaDatasetName: Northshore School District 2026–2027 Family Calendar Dataset
schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Northshore School District dates for 2026–27, including first and last school days, Wednesday early release, elementary conference early dismissals, Winter Break, Mid-Winter Break, Spring Break, teacher grading/non-student day, commencement-related early dismissals, emergency make-up days, and translated calendar files.
calendarNotes: The NSD Family Calendar marks September 1 as the first day for most grades, but schools communicate first-day, last-day, and half-day schedules directly to families. Wednesday early release begins September 9 and dismisses students 1½ hours early unless noted. Elementary conference early dismissals appear on specific November dates and February 5. January 25 is a teacher grading/non-student day. Graduation week includes commencement dates and early dismissals for grades 9–11 at specific high schools. Emergency make-up days may be added to the end of the year if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Wednesday early release start in NSD?
calendarFaqs.a: It starts Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026. Students are usually dismissed 1½ hours earlier than normal, but families should check their school for exact times.

calendarFaqs.q: Are NSD elementary conference days districtwide no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They are early-dismissal dates for elementary schools, not districtwide closures. Middle and high schools follow their regular schedules unless they announce a change.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the NSD last day change?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The scheduled last day is June 16, 2027, but NSD lists June 17, June 21, and June 22 as emergency make-up days if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded NSD calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and will not automatically update if NSD revises the calendar.

customSections.label: What NSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few details on the district calendar can affect pickup times, child care, and end-of-year plans.

groups.label: Check your school for first-day, last-day, and half-day times
items: NSD sets the dates, but each school sends its own start and dismissal times for Sept. 1, Nov. 25, and June 16.

groups.label: Wednesday early release begins September 9
items: Students are dismissed 1½ hours early on Wednesdays beginning Sept. 9 unless NSD announces a different schedule.

groups.label: Conference early dismissals are for elementary schools only
items: Elementary schools have early dismissals for conferences on November 17, November 19–20, November 23–24, and February 5 by invitation only.
Middle and high school schedules are not affected unless the school announces otherwise.

groups.label: Graduation week has school-specific early dismissals
items: Graduation week changes the schedule for grades 9–11 at North Creek, Woodinville, Inglemoor, and Bothell high schools. North Creek and Woodinville dismiss students in grades 9–11 early on June 14; Inglemoor and Bothell do so on June 15.

customSections.label: Commencements and Grades 9–11 Early Dismissals
customSections.content: NSD lists commencement dates on the family calendar and marks early dismissals for grades 9–11 at certain high schools during graduation week.

sourceReviewSummary: Dates on this page were checked against the NSD 2026–27 English Family Calendar PDF and the district calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the first day for most grades, weekly early-release note, elementary-only conference early dismissals, Winter Break, Mid-Winter Break, Spring Break, teacher grading/non-student day, commencements, school-specific early dismissals, and emergency make-up days against the official NSD PDF.

NSD notes that schools communicate schedules for the first day, last day, and half day directly to families. This page preserves that distinction instead of treating those dates as ordinary full days.
Early Childhood and Religious and Cultural Observances calendars are separate NSD resources available through the district calendar page.
If NSD publishes a revised Family Calendar, we update this page and the review date.
